speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked	the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider requiring employers to pay work permit holders through an electronic payment system, given that this is already required of employers of S Pass holders.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpowe)
text: Nonetheless, Mdm Speaker, my Ministry will continue to conduct periodical policy reviews.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpowe)
text: We will continue to monitor the situation and review our laws to ensure that adequate convenience and protection will be put in place for our workers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Just one clarification – if the worker does request to be paid by Electronic Payment System and the company rejects, can he/she then seek help from MOM?

speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
text: For workers who have difficulties in salary matters or other manpower matters, they can always dial the MOM hotline number at 64385122.
